title: Hover-paragraph affordance for in-prose feedback attach
description: The bundle shows a quiet bordered outline + '+' icon at the right margin when the learner hovers a paragraph WHILE the feedback panel is open, clicking it pre-fills the composer's section-anchor pill. Stage 3 ships the panel + composer but not this in-prose hover affordance. Needs: (a) detect 'feedback panel open' state, (b) wrap each paragraph in a hoverable container, (c) on hover, render the +-button, (d) on click, populate the composer's anchor + scroll the panel into view.

title: Wire selection popover + note popover to real text selections
description: Stage 3 ships the SelectionPopoverDemo and NoteComposePopoverDemo as fixed-positioned demo-only components in lesson-widgets.tsx. Real implementation needs: (a) listen to window.getSelection() events in the prose body, (b) anchor the selection popover to range.getBoundingClientRect(), (c) render persistent <HighlightSpan> components by replacing the selected range with a wrapped span, (d) anchor the note compose popover to the highlight's right margin, (e) keep selection state out of LessonWidgets surface state machine since it's selection-driven not toggle-driven.

title: Section-anchor format + MDX stamping for feedback composer
description: The feedback composer's 'attach to section' affordance needs a stable anchor format: { lessonId, pageNumber, sectionType: 'paragraph'|'code'|'image'|'heading', ordinalWithinPage }. Stamped on every prose block at MDX compile time so the composer can auto-detect the current scroll-position anchor. Stage 3 widget code (lesson-widgets.tsx) hardcodes a placeholder 'PAGE 4 · PARAGRAPH 1' anchor in the composer.

title: Backend: lesson_notes table + selection-range serialisation
description: Persistence for the highlight/notes widget shipped in Stage 3 of the design-bundle port. Schema: lesson_notes(id, learnerId, lessonId, pageNumber, selectionRange, noteBody, createdAt) private to the learner. Selection-range serialisation: text-offset pair (startNode, startOffset, endNode, endOffset) resolved against a stable per-page node map (path-by-ordinal, NOT DOM ids) so highlights survive prose edits. Currently mocked in lesson-widgets.tsx via MOCK_NOTE_GROUPS.

title: Backend: lesson_feedback + lesson_feedback_replies tables
description: Persistence for the feedback widget shipped in Stage 3 of the design-bundle port. Schema per the design bundle BRIEF: lesson_feedback(id, learnerId, lessonId, pageNumber, sectionAnchor, body, createdAt) + lesson_feedback_replies(id, feedbackId, staffUserId, body, createdAt) + per-learner unread flag that drives the terracotta dot on the FEEDBACK pill. Read access scoped to learner + staff role. Currently mocked in src/app/(dashboard)/course/[slug]/lesson/[lessonSlug]/lesson-widgets.tsx via MOCK_COMMENTS.
